research.title: Post-Training Leaves Behavioral Shadows on Unrelated Decisions
research.why: Most significant and most discussed paper of the window (top of HF Daily Papers on Sep 29, 262 upvotes): it shows a student model can pick up a teacher's capabilities from a single teacher-chosen word per prompt of unrelated text, extending 'subliminal learning'. For a general reader that is a clear, surprising finding with safety and policy stakes (hidden trait transfer; distillation as a competition issue, per the related HN thread). DATE CAVEAT: arXiv submission is Sep 24, before the window; it is included because its main momentum (HF feature, discussion) came on Sep 29 inside the window, and the piece should say 'posted last week, drew attention this week'. Label as a preprint, not yet peer-reviewed. Primary source is arXiv, fully readable.

news.title: NVIDIA launches Open Agent Safety Platform (OpenShell + Sentry) with 100+ organizations
news.why: Dated Sep 28 inside the window, with a readable primary source (NVIDIA press release fetched directly). It is an industry-wide effort to police AI agents: Sentry runs on BlueField-4 DPUs as an out-of-band watchdog that NVIDIA says can quarantine agents in milliseconds, with Anthropic, Microsoft, Salesforce and JPMorganChase joining. Strong discussion (HN 226 pts / 298 comments) plus a clear news hook in OpenAI's absence (TechCrunch, Sep 29: https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/29/heres-why-openai-is-absent-from-nvidias-industry-wide-effort-to-end-rogue-ai-agents/). Attribute performance claims to NVIDIA. Chosen over GPT-6.1 Sol because OpenAI's pages return 403 and that story currently rests on an RSS description and HN title.

invention.title: Jeff: tiny fine-tuned classifiers that return calibrated probabilities in one forward pass
invention.why: In window (repo Sep 28, v1.1 on Sep 29), fast-growing (1,176 stars by Sep 30), and something readers can safely try: 0.8B/2B open 'decision models' built on Qwen3.5/Gemma 4 that pick among up to 254 options zero-shot in about 22 ms on a GPU or about 28 ms on an Apple M4 Max, with probabilities attached rather than free text. Honest caveat angle: small models, speed and calibration numbers are the authors' own claims; the deep-diver should verify the benchmarks and the stated link to 'Jev' (TypeSafe AI) from the README before using them. Excluded the higher-scoring 'dots' web agent because its main selling point is an anti-detection browser built to evade bot blocking, which does not fit a general-audience spotlight. Excluded HN.watch because its AI angle was unverified.

thread: Both the research and news picks are about what AI does out of sight: a paper finding that models can pass on behaviors through text that looks unrelated, and an industry platform built to watch and quarantine agents from outside the model.
